## @interlace/choice-card

Installed to `components/ui/choice-card.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/choice-card';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/choice-card

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
